decisions.scenario: Getting the Fitzwilliam Museum postcode and then checking a train from Broxbourne to Cambridge

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: I'm looking for the Fitzwilliam Museum.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: The Fitzwilliam Museum is on Trumpington Street. Would you like any other information about it?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Could you give me the exact postcode, please?

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Yes. The postcode is CB2 1RB. Is there anything else I can help with?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Yes. I'm also looking for a train from Broxbourne to Cambridge.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Train TR5570 is an option for that journey.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Great. Thank you very much for your help.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Is there anything else I can do for you today?

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: You're welcome. Have a wonderful day. Goodbye.

decisions.notes: Retained because the Fitzwilliam Museum postcode CB2 1RB adds source-backed coverage not present in the existing Fitzwilliam Museum dialogue; the train request is preserved without inventing schedule details.

Rejected for learner-facing incoherence: the assistant identifies TR2503 and then gives three different departure times for that single train. Repairing which departure time belongs to the train would require inference beyond editorial normalization.

Rejected as a semantic near-duplicate of already reviewed Huntingdon Marriott Hotel, Cambridge Belfry, and University Arms Hotel content (including dlg.multiwoz.pmul1645.json, dlg.multiwoz.sng0785.json, and dlg.multiwoz.ssng0342.json); the candidate adds no materially new learner-facing hotel fact.

Rejected for learner-facing incoherence: after the learner repeatedly specifies a cheap east-side place with free Wi-Fi, the assistant asks for the price range again and ends without resolving the request.

Rejected for identity inconsistency: after recommending Avalon and being asked which area it is in, the assistant answers with the area of A and B Guesthouse instead. Repairing the intended property would require inference beyond editorial normalization.
Rejected as a semantic near-duplicate of dlg.multiwoz.mul2676.json, which already covers City Centre North B&B as a cheap zero-star place to stay with richer location, parking, and Wi-Fi details.
